areas.title: Core product promise and epistemic boundaries
areas.review_focus: Review the five epistemic layers, absolute integrity invariants, and the rule that lower layers cannot rewrite higher layers.
areas.review_summary: Source review and owner discussion completed in this conversation on 2026-10-09. Product Constitution v1.6.1 establishes CE's identity and absolute integrity invariants; Calculation Constitution v1.9 defines the numerical/geometric source-of-record boundary and prohibits invented/synthetic/stale state; Signal Engine v1.4 and Interpretive Canon v1.2 preserve downstream qualification/interpretive boundaries; Evidence, AI & Output Validation v1.4 limits AI to authorized language infrastructure and fail-closed claim validation. Preserve the core invariant: CE must never make the user believe CE knows more than CE actually knows. Normative and governance sources jointly constrain CE; working artifacts, convenience, commercial goals, or autonomous operation cannot override them.

areas.title: Look Back, Look Today, Tomorrow Check, Look Future and Quiet Sky
areas.review_focus: Review product time model and distinguish a valid no-signal observation from technical failure.
areas.review_summary: Source-level semantic review completed against the characterized V1 stack. Look Back is experience-first, controlled-category, session-only and not truth proof; Look Today may show only qualified Testable Sky Signal; Tomorrow Check receives the user's categorical report and compares it with yesterday's testable signal without forcing mismatch to match; Look Future is grounded in upcoming calculations, Canon, and only explicitly permitted current-session input, and remains possibility not guarantee. Quiet Sky is the aggregate result of a valid completed observation with zero qualifying signals. Any non-VALID technical state remains a separate failure/unavailable state: no signal, Canon claim, Quiet Sky promotion, or stale substitution. This is semantic/source reconciliation only, not runtime conformance or test execution; exact byte lineage of the characterized copies to the representative governing archive remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
